correctness.rationale: The claim concerns the integral elementary-symmetric intersection V(e1,e2,e3), not naive reduction of power sums (which would make the quadratic redundant in char2). Exact independent GF(4) symbolic multiplication verifies that the parametrization [s^3:(s+t)^3:(s+ωt)^3:(s+ω²t)^3:t^3] satisfies e1=e2=e3=0. On H=e1=0 the polar form of e2 is nondegenerate, so e2 defines a smooth quadric; e3 is not identically zero there, giving a degree-six pure complete intersection. Two distinct conjugate degree-three rational curves exhaust that degree. Five explicit F2 common points and bidegrees (1,2)/(2,1) on the quadric force intersection multiplicity exactly five and ordinary transverse nodes; arithmetic genus 4 follows via the dual graph. Frobenius interchanges components, forcing counts #B(F_{2^n})=5 for odd n and 2^{n+1}-3 for even n. Zeta exp of counts is (1+T)^4/((1-T)(1-4T²)); independent projective enumeration over F2,F4,F8,F16 yields 5,5,5,29.
residual_risks: The theorem is model-specific: does not identify stable reduction of every integral Bring model.
Finite field checks up to F16 corroborate but do not prove extension counts; geometric component proof does.

value.rationale: Determines a natural arithmetic-geometric degeneration of a canonical genus-four curve at the delicate characteristic-two prime, including exact geometric components, five nodes, arithmetic genus, stability and all extension-field counts/zeta. The distinction between valid flat elementary-symmetric model and naive power-sum reduction is mathematically essential.
residual_risks: Result is an exact theorem for the displayed model, not an all-model stable reduction classification.

final_claim: The characteristic-two elementary-symmetric Bring curve is the transverse union of two Frobenius-conjugate twisted cubics at five F2 nodes, a stable genus-four curve with #B(F2^n)=5 for odd n and 2^(n+1)-3 for even n and zeta (1+T)^4/((1-T)(1-4T^2)).
limitations: This model is not the naive reduction of characteristic-zero power sums.
Priority against alternative-model bad-reduction literature is qualified.
